title: Parkview Dental Partners Appoints Jon Gregoire as CEO
html:
Experienced DSO executive and former founder brings a proven track record of driving organic growth, operational excellence, and M&A.

Parkview Dental Partners, a leading dental service organization (DSO) backed by Cathay Capital, today announced the appointment of Jon Gregoire as Chief Executive Officer. Gregoire, a veteran DSO operator and former founder, will lead Parkview’s next phase of growth.

“Jon has spent his career building and scaling dental organizations from the practice level up, giving him a rare understanding of what drives performance for doctors, teams, and patients,” said Mark Woods, Partner and Head of North American Private Equity at Cathay Capital. “His combination of operating discipline, entrepreneurial experience, and M&A expertise makes him the right leader for Parkview’s next chapter.”

Gregoire brings more than 20 years of leadership experience in dental service organizations, spanning clinic-level operations, entrepreneurship, practice integration, and mergers and acquisitions. In 2018, he co-founded Cornerstone Dental Partners and served as its Chief Operating Officer. He helped grow the company to 10 locations, 22 doctors, and 110 team members before its sale to P1 Dental Partners in 2021. He then served as COO of P1 for the past five years, where he drove organic and inorganic growth across the business. Throughout his career, he has been involved in more than 30 dental acquisitions, leading all aspects of the process, from sourcing and deal structuring through negotiation, closing, and integration.

“Parkview has built a differentiated partnership model grounded in clinical excellence, strong doctor relationships, and high-quality operational support,” said Gregoire. “I am excited to join the Company at this important point in its growth and to work alongside Parkview’s doctors, clinical leaders, and team members. Together, we will continue strengthening the operating foundation, supporting our affiliated practices, and thoughtfully expanding Parkview’s presence along the Gulf Coast of Florida while preserving the culture and patient-first approach that set the organization apart.”

Founded in 2018 and based in Sarasota, Florida, Parkview supports general and specialty dental practices across Florida’s Gulf Coast. Cathay Capital invested in Parkview in 2023 to help accelerate the company’s expansion through organic growth, new partnerships, and acquisitions while maintaining its focus on clinical excellence and exceptional patient and provider experiences.

About Parkview Dental Partners

Parkview is a dentist-founded dental growth and management partnership that is decidedly different from corporate DSOs. Based in Sarasota, Florida, its mission is to support like-minded dentists who want to focus on providing clinically excellent care and a great patient experience while Parkview provides the highest level of operational support and opportunities for professional growth. For more information, visit www.parkviewdp.com.

About Cathay Capital

Cathay Capital is a global private equity and venture capital investment firm supporting healthcare, technology, and consumer companies throughout North America, Europe, and Asia. The firm helps middle-market companies and startups navigate opportunities for growth, international expansion, and sustainable transformation. Its platform connects people with global reach and local expertise—from investors and entrepreneurs to management teams and leading corporations—to share knowledge and the tools to scale and transform businesses.

Founded in 2007 with a strong entrepreneurial heritage, Cathay Capital now manages more than $7 billion in assets. It has made more than 320 investments from offices in New York, San Francisco, Paris, Munich, Berlin, Madrid, Mexico City, Shanghai, Beijing, and Singapore. For more information, visit www.cathaycapital.com.
